newsitem.title: USA: Calif Treasurer sells debt for foundation, hospital.
newsitem.headline: Calif Treasurer sells debt for foundation, hospital.

text.p: California state Treasurer Matt Fong said on Monday $5.8 million of bonds were sold for the Foundation for Educational Achievement.
The foundation will use the bond proceeds to refinance debt on its administration building in San Diego and certain debt of its affiliate, Cogswell College in Sunnyvale, Calif.
The bonds were issued through the California Educational Facilities Authority of the state Treasurer's office.

Separately, Fong announced the sale of $3.7 million in a tax-exempt revenue note for Dameron Hospital Association of Stockton, California. The note proceeds will be used to fund renovations and new equipment.
